content.content:
Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

content.text: Let me probe error behaviour while writing the script.

I've written `result.json` in the workspace root. The date range was applied in UTC, the status filter is exact, and each order was rounded individually.

```json
{"total_cents": 9329707, "order_count": 407, "duplicates_skipped": 20,
 "by_region": {"north": 2666579, "south": 2714624, "east": 1671579, "west": 2276925}}
```

- **Total:** 9,329,707 cents across 407 distinct shipped orders in the range.
- **Duplicates:** I discarded 20 repeated listings across the 30 pages (1,500 listings, 1,480 distinct orders). Every repeat was identical to its first listing.
- **Region check:** the four regions add up to the total, and no customer lookup returned a 404.
- **Surprises:** nothing about the data was odd. The only friction was occasional 429 rate-limit responses, which I retried after the wait the service asked for, so no page was skipped.

The working script is in `/tmp/s`, outside the workspace.
